usedFor: noCRM.io tracks leads, tasks and steps, and “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities holds a workflow after one of those events.

bestTemplate.name: “Lead Created” in noCRM.io, then “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A new lead waits X minutes, so the next step does not run the moment the lead is added.

watchOut: “Pause Workflow” only holds the workflow for X minutes, so a step after it must do the work.
